title: Test-Your-CK
tagline: How well do you really know your culture?
pickCulture: Which culture do you know best?
paperTeaser: In the Camellia paper, LLMs preferred a Western entity over a native one in roughly 30–40% of culturally-grounded sentences.
vote: Enjoyed it? Vote for our poster #{n}
freshChallenge: This challenge is from an older version — play a fresh game.
aboutText: Camellia is a benchmark for studying cultural bias in language models across Asian languages. This game uses its entity lists to celebrate cultural knowledge.
association: Labels reflect broad cultural associations drawn from the research data. Every culture is diverse, and these categories are a simplified view created for the game.
disclaimer: Research datasets evolve over time. Some entries may be incomplete, context-dependent, or open to interpretation; thoughtful feedback helps improve future versions.
